_README: Rules engine. Copy this file to rules.local.json (gitignored), then edit. Each rule defines a condition + how often to check + what message to send to Telegram. The check_rules.py script reads this and fires Telegram alerts.

_check_types.balance_below: Alert when ad account prepaid balance drops below threshold (in account currency). Re-fires every check_every until balance is topped up.
_check_types.balance_zero_or_negative: Alert when ad account ran out of money (balance <= 0). Re-fires every check_every until topped up.
_check_types.insights_summary: Send the standard insights summary for the last N hours/days.
_check_types.roas_below: Alert when ROAS over the lookback drops below threshold.
_check_types.cpa_above: Alert when CPA over the lookback rises above threshold.
_check_types.frequency_above: Alert when account-level frequency over lookback rises above threshold (creative fatigue).
_check_types.no_spend: Alert when account had zero spend for the entire lookback window.

rules.description: Warn when balance < 1000 EGP. Repeats hourly until topped up.
rules.message: ⚠️ *{ad_account_label}* balance dropped below {threshold} {currency}. Current: {balance} {currency}. Top up now to avoid pause.

rules.description: Critical: ad account balance is zero or negative — campaigns may already be paused.
rules.message: 🚨 *{ad_account_label}* is OUT OF MONEY (balance: {balance} {currency}). Campaigns likely paused. Top up immediately.

rules.description: Send a performance summary every 12 hours (last 12h window).
Alert if 24h ROAS drops below break-even.
rules.message: 🔻 *{ad_account_label}* ROAS dropped to {value:.2f}x (below floor {threshold}x) over the last 24h.

rules.description: Warn when account-level frequency > 4 (creative fatigue risk).
Alert if no spend recorded today (possible pause / billing issue).
rules.message: ⏸  *{ad_account_label}* has zero spend in the last 24h. Check for pauses, depleted budget, or billing issues.
